items.problem: Dependent scaffold/bootstrap/self-check and build/launch/validation commands were repeatedly issued in parallel, causing races and file locks.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 1-2 show bootstrap racing the scaffold; lines 2913-2923, 3382-3415, 3572-3608, and 4467-4518 show input.json/CS2012/WMC9999 locks and contradictory launch outcomes.
items.covered_at: SKILL.md Step 0 called them the 'first three commands'; Step 3 said 'build -> fix -> launch -> repeat'; Step 4 required validation.
items.proposed_improvement: State that each dependent command must finish before the next is issued, prohibit batching/parallel execution, and name the lock signatures this prevents.
items.generalizes: WinUI XAML compilation and packaged app launches share obj/bin files, so parallel orchestration destabilizes any migration.
